QuestInfo.name: [Dual Blade Rebirth] A New Blade Rises
QuestInfo.0: Reborn Dual Blade! There is a gift in store for you.
QuestInfo.1: The Administrator gave you a gift to commemorate the rebirth of a Dual Blade.
QuestInfo.2: This reborn Dual Blade is now Level 15. Retrieve your gift from the Maple Administrator! There will be more where that came from!

0.0: Look at you, #b#h0##k! You're doing so well on your journey to become a new and more powerful Dual Blade that I can't resist the urge to give you a present. Do you accept?

no.0: If you change your mind, don't forget to come back and find me!

yes.0: Now, if you don't open the gift box I gave you within a #rweek#k, it'll disappear. So don't forget to use it, okay?

default.0: Hmm, please talk to me again after checking your inventory.
